hooks.name: Quality gate on writes
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to validate every write against project conventions before proceeding.

action.prompt: Before completing this write operation, verify: 1) The code follows TypeScript strict mode (no 'any', proper types). 2) It respects the project structure in .kiro/steering/structure.md. 3) It does NOT modify business formulas without explicit user approval. 4) It uses existing patterns (EventBus, game.registry, ApiClient conventions). 5) If creating a new file, confirm it belongs in the correct directory per project structure.
